text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling pollinator community responses to hypothetical land-use changes driven by bioenergy scenarios, not on predicting or simulating land use/land cover (LULC) change itself. It uses existing land cover data and predefined conversion scenarios as inputs to an ecological model. The primary research question concerns ecological impacts (bee abundance/diversity/composition), not LULC prediction. While it involves spatial analysis and scenario comparison, it lacks a core LULC prediction or simulation model, does not generate new LULC projections, and does not report quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC prediction. It therefore fails the core inclusion criteria of having LULC prediction as its primary focus and providing spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC.)
